scope: Synthetic-only mathematical 2D pretraining, one fixed natural reference crop per target; natural development labels used for engineering and cutoff calibration, never weight updates

measured_previous_failures.v19_generic_proposal_dev_coverage_at_iou: 42/42 pairs before learned ranking; many more proposals, not a detection-accuracy result

changes_to_test: Independent deformations and materials of reusable 2D construction graphs, including type-defining micro-hole patterns
Near negatives change one connection or local mark; independently check the edit remains visibly different after rendering, occlusion and camera effects
Keep local and contextual descriptors separate and supervise the final matching representation with visible point correspondences
Do not label common parts in near-negative objects as mismatches solely because the whole type differs
Train conditional region scores against IoU-qualified targets and nonmatching regions, not loose crop-presence labels
Use generic multiscale regions and explicit image-pyramid scale normalization instead of a pretrained-on-synthetic objectness filter that excludes true regions

prior_art.title: SuperPoint: Self-Supervised Interest Point Detection and Description
prior_art.relevance: Synthetic shape bootstrapping and descriptor correspondence supervision are established ideas. Its adaptation to natural imagery is not evidence that our mathematical-only category recognizer will transfer.

prior_art.title: Learning to See by Looking at Noise
prior_art.relevance: Procedural image statistics and diversity can support representation pretraining. This does not establish one-reference semantic detection without natural training.

prior_art.title: SegRCDB: Semantic Segmentation via Formula-Driven Supervised Learning
prior_art.relevance: Formula-driven masks and occluding 2D shapes support pretraining; reported downstream segmentation results include natural-data fine-tuning.

prior_art.title: Few-Shot Pattern Detection via Template Matching and Regression
prior_art.relevance: Spatially retained exemplar matching and template-conditioned localization already exist; the published approach uses a frozen backbone.

novelty_status: Engineering hypothesis under test; no verified new algorithm or superiority claim
limits: Procedural program identities are not natural semantic categories
Visible counterfactual differences do not prove disjoint type distributions under every allowed deformation
Matching broad image statistics is a diagnostic coverage check, not proof of natural-image transfer
Generic proposal coverage is an upper bound before ranking and acceptance; more proposals can increase false alarms
Fresh photos will be new to HyperNet development, not proven unseen by the pretrained OWL baseline
